newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil recovers.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil recovers.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Thursday, gas oil falling with futures ahead of the expiry, while fuel oil recovered from initial weakness, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were down over $1 a tonne as IPE June gas oil futures weakened ahead of their expiry at 1100 GMT on Thursday.
Prompt premiums increased slightly to June +$1.75 fob Rotterdam. Traders said the rise was so as to allow a premium rather than a discount to July IPE futures which take over from June today.
Delivery against the expired June futures was expected to be around 250,000-200,000 tonnes, although a number of exchange for physical deals were likely to be completed.
High sulphur fuel oil barges initially traded at $83 fob Rotterdam, but soon rose to $85 fob, a price done a couple of times, as one major stepped in to buy.
